items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: He was in there. Schatz, Wilson, and another fellow... You took Schatz's place that day.

ctx.x: That's right. In St. Glover. One Sunday I went back here. Alright.
And I had Schatz. Yeah, yeah. He was in there. Schatz, Wilson, and another fellow.
Yeah, he died. Yeah, he took a corner, he died. I forget his name. Him.
